tips.text: Run the Granum Void solo on normal, not Steel Path; every extra squad member adds 25 kills to the requirement.
Waypoint a Golden Hand first, kill the capture target, then come back and insert the Crown; restart if no hand has shown up halfway through the tile.
Stay on top of the Void's enemies with a chaining or nuking weapon; about 20 spawn at a time and nothing new arrives until that batch is dead.
Heavy-attack the Granum ghosts to charge the Xoris, and kill Parvos units for the time triangles they drop.
Kill the Treasurer every cycle for the next Crown, and hit Replay on the white end screen to re-run instantly.
Do the Conservation standing runs solo on normal.
